description: Change the import options of placed graphics without the dialog: Photoshop clipping path, alpha channel, which layers are visible and what happens to them when the link updates, and the item's display quality (Object > Image Import Options, Object > Object Layer Options, Object > Display Performance). For colour profile and rendering intent use set_image_color_settings

alphaChannel.description: Alpha Channel to mask the image with, by name

applyClippingPath.description: Apply Photoshop Clipping Path saved in the image

displayQuality.description: Display Performance for these items: DEFAULT_VALUE (use the view setting), HIGH_QUALITY, TYPICAL or OPTIMIZED (fast)

layers.description: Show Layers: layer visibility by name; a nested layer as "Group/Layer"

target.description: Frames holding the graphics, or the graphics. Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

whenUpdatingLink.description: When Updating Link: keep these layer visibility overrides, or use the file's own visibility

name: set_placed_graphic_options
title: Set Placed Graphic Options
